claim: Rapamycin delays aging in fruit flies.
b2_rationale: The cited abstract reports that feeding rapamycin to adult fruit flies extends their lifespan, supporting the claim that it delays aging.

claim: Side effects associated with antidepressants increases risk of stroke.
b2_rationale: The study reported a higher adjusted hazard of stroke or transient ischaemic attack among users of “other antidepressants” than among nonusers. This supports an association with increased risk, although it does not establish causation.

claim: Tonic signaling from the scFv induces constitutive stimulation.
b2_rationale: The abstract describes antigen-independent clustering of CAR scFvs triggering tonic CAR signaling, i.e., ongoing signaling without antigen. This supports the claim’s description of constitutive stimulation.
